units.source_text: 千重子到了后面楼上，慢条斯理地把衣服换下来稍坐片刻，然后再下楼来。

en.t: Chieko went upstairs to the rooms in the back, leisurely changed out of her clothes and sat for a little while, then came back downstairs.

units.source_text: 母亲已经把三点钟那顿点心给店员们分发完了。

en.t: Her mother had already finished handing out the three o'clock snack to the shop employees.
